title: Hilli, 24 Nov 1971: he went through the bunkers (Ram Ugrah Pandey, Maha Vir Chakra)
why: 7:00 PM IST (founder order, 2 Nov). Battle of Hilli, 55th anniversary (22–24 Nov 1971). Rebuilt on CoS return as ONE hero's fight: Ram Ugrah Pandey of 8 Guards, three bunkers, Maha Vir Chakra (posthumous), every beat from the Tribune feature. Cause and effect: sent to bypass → bunker one → bunker two → rocket launcher, bunker three → gave his life → Hilli taken 11 Dec. Hook is an action line, not a 'count + award' formula. Name and award only, no rank on screen.
en:
🎁 Veterans: first 500 to register get exclusive brand vouchers. Link in bio.
Hilli, 24 November 1971. His section's job: get past the bunkers. He went through them.

55 years ago this week, in the east, 8 Guards met an entrenched position at Hilli. Ram Ugrah Pandey's section was sent to work round it.

He crawled up to the first bunker and destroyed it with a grenade. Then the second. Then he picked up a rocket launcher and destroyed the third, and was mortally wounded. He gave his life on the spot.

Maha Vir Chakra (posthumous). 8 Guards won two more at Hilli: Shamsher Singh, who led the battalion, and Shamsher Singh Samra (posthumous). On 11 December 1971, Hilli was taken.

The bunkers fell. His name still stands.

title: Before you sign this year's gifting order (Rakshak Business)
why: 09:30 IST (founder's LinkedIn slot, Tue). Rakshak Business for buyers: December gifting and year-end vendor season. Asks HR, admin and procurement heads to put one veteran- or Rakshak Nari-run business on the list. New ask and audience (W7-l1 asked investors; W3/W4 lenders). No sales promised, no partner names, no deal terms.
en:
Before you sign this year's year-end gifting order, ask one question: was any of it made by someone who served?

December is when companies buy: hampers and diaries for clients, gifts for teams, vendor contracts for the new year. Most of it goes to the same few suppliers every year.

About 60,000 men and women retire from active military service in India every year. Many of them, and many of their spouses, start businesses: security and facility services, logistics, catering, training, handloom, tailoring, food. The government already trusts veterans with serious enterprises; the DGR's self-employment schemes include security agencies, CNG stations and oil product agencies. Programmes like Sainikpreneur incubate veteran startups.

What these businesses usually lack is not quality. It is a place on someone's list.

That is what we are building with Rakshak Business on Rakshak ID: a place where a business run by a veteran, a Rakshak Nari or an Agniveer can be seen by the 2.5 crore-strong uniformed family, and by companies that want to buy from those who served.

My ask is small. Put one veteran- or Rakshak Nari-run business on this year's gifting or vendor list.

Procurement and HR leaders: what would you need to see to add a verified veteran-run business to your vendor list? Tell me in the comments. I read every one.

https://rakshakid.com

Col Arvind Vannur, Veteran
Founder, Rakshak ID

#RakshakID #VeteranEntrepreneurs #BuyFromVeterans

why: 7:00 PM IST (founder order, 2 Nov). Founder priority theme Rakshak Business, pegged to Lachit Diwas (24 Nov; history in one line, no politics). Assam Rifles leads for the first time; brotherhood of an all-veteran crew from three forces. Framed as what we are working on; no sales promised.

24 November, Lachit Diwas. In 1671, Lachit Borphukan held the Brahmaputra. Today an Assam Rifles veteran runs a business on it.

After 22 years with the Assam Rifles, Bhaskar put his savings into an old wooden river boat in Guwahati, and hired only veterans of the Assam Rifles, the BSF and the Army. Every cruise began with a parade-style life-jacket drill.

First monsoon: a squall hits mid-river with 40 people on board.

The crew had drilled for exactly this. Every jacket on in under a minute. All 40 home safe.

Lachit held this river with soldiers. Bhaskar runs it with them.

November 2026: the first Agniveers step out of uniform. Day 1, Deepak rolls up the shutter of his own shop.

Four years in the Army, he kept the generators running at posts where nothing else worked. Now it's Deepak Electricals.

Day 1, 11 PM. A call from two lanes away: an old veteran's oxygen machine has stopped. The inverter is dead, and every other shop is shut.

Day 2, 9 AM: three new customers at his shutter, sent by the veteran's family.

Out of uniform. Still on call.

title: 20 days to launch: what we launch with, and three things we will never do
why: 09:30 IST (founder's LinkedIn slot, Thu). Build-in-public plus Trust (PLAN.md themes 6 and 7): a plain status note 20 days before the 16 Dec launch, PLAN.md product facts only. No partner names, no deal terms, no invented registration numbers.
en:
Twenty days from now, on Vijay Diwas, 16 December, Rakshak ID goes live. Here is exactly what we are launching with, and three things we will never do.

What we launch with:
One Rakshak Number, with a verified card for each member of the family: veterans, Veer Naris, Rakshak Naris, Agniveers and their families, across the Army, Navy, Air Force, Coast Guard, Assam Rifles and every CAPF.
Registration is free.
Verification happens inside the app, and documents are deleted within 72 hours.
Rakshak Business, taking shape: a place where a business run by a veteran, a Rakshak Nari or an Agniveer can be seen by the parivar.
For early members: the first 500 veterans, Rakshak Naris, Agniveers, fauji brats and CAPF families to register (500 in each group) get exclusive brand vouchers, curated for them, in the app from 16 December.

Three things we will never do:
1. Promise outcomes. We are a platform for a 2.5 crore-strong family. We connect; we do not pretend to guarantee.
2. Sell your data. Not to a partner, not to anyone.
3. Call a Rakshak Nari a "dependent". She is a member in her own right.

Rakshak ID is not affiliated with the Ministry of Defence.

What would make you trust a new platform with your family's details? Tell me; I read every comment.

https://rakshakid.com

Col Arvind Vannur, Veteran
Founder, Rakshak ID

en:
26/11. 18 years.
🎁 Veterans: first 500 to register get exclusive brand vouchers. Link in bio.

26 November 2008, Mumbai. Shot again and again, he kept fighting. About 150 people got out alive.

Indian Navy MARCOS went in at the Taj. Praveen Kumar Teotia, shot again and again, kept engaging until his team had rescued about 150 people. Shaurya Chakra.

The NSG ended the four-day attack there with Operation Black Tornado. Sandeep Unnikrishnan and Gajender Singh Bisht: Ashoka Chakra (posthumous).

Mumbai Police: Tukaram Omble, unarmed, held on to an attacker's rifle, and his team took that attacker alive. Ashoka Chakra (posthumous). Before the police, he served in the Army.

Never ever: the name of the NSG's remembrance at the Gateway of India.

What we are working on: a thank-you that lasts all year, for veterans of every force and their families.

Veterans and CAPF families: whom do you remember tonight? Comment a name.

Veterans, this one's yours. The first 500 veterans to register get exclusive brand vouchers, curated for veterans. Register early at rakshakid.com, link in bio.

Not affiliated with the Ministry of Defence. AI-generated visuals (illustrative scene).

hi:
26/11। 18 साल।
🎁 वेटरन्स: रजिस्टर करने वाले पहले 500 को ख़ास ब्रांड वाउचर। लिंक बायो में।

ताज में MARCOS प्रवीण कुमार तेवतिया को बार-बार गोलियाँ लगीं, फिर भी वो डटे रहे, जब तक उनकी टीम ने क़रीब 150 लोगों को बचा नहीं लिया। शौर्य चक्र।

NSG ने ऑपरेशन ब्लैक टॉरनेडो से हमला ख़त्म किया। संदीप उन्नीकृष्णन और गजेंद्र सिंह बिष्ट: अशोक चक्र (मरणोपरांत)।

मुंबई पुलिस के तुकाराम ओंबले ने, ख़ुद निहत्थे होकर, हमलावर की राइफ़ल पकड़े रखी; उनकी टीम ने उसे ज़िंदा पकड़ा। अशोक चक्र (मरणोपरांत)।

नेवर एवर। 18 साल बाद भी।

आज रात आप किसे याद कर रहे हैं? कमेंट में एक नाम लिखिए।
ये पोस्ट उस वेटरन को भेजिए जो 26/11 कभी नहीं भूले।

🎁 Rakshak Naris: first 500 to register get exclusive brand vouchers. Link in bio.
Wedding season. One sewing machine. Twelve fauji wives on her payroll.

Swati, an Air Force wife and trained fashion designer, is posted to a remote Air Force station. Nearest market: two hours away.

Around her, wives with real skill in embroidery, tailoring and zari work. But one machine is not a business.

So she turned the station's free hall into a studio. She trains, they stitch, and wedding orders come in from fauji families at other stations.

One machine. Twelve paychecks. One station.

What we are working on: Rakshak Business, where Rakshak Naris, veterans and Agniveers put their business in front of 2.5 crore Rakshaks and their families.

en:
🎁 Agniveers: first 500 to register get exclusive brand vouchers. Link in bio.
18,000+ Agniveers. Four years done. These doors are open.

The first batch: 24,400 strong (about 19,000 Army, 2,850 Air Force, 2,550 Navy). More than 18,000 step out of uniform by 31 December 2026.

Door 1, the CAPFs: ex-Agniveers are to fill half of entry-level posts in the BSF, CRPF, CISF, ITBP and Assam Rifles, with no written test and an age relaxation. The BSF turns 62 on 1 December.
Door 2: police in Haryana, Rajasthan and Maharashtra, the Railways, the Coast Guard.
Door 3: quotas in 16 Defence PSUs.
Always check the latest official notification before you apply.

What we are working on: four years in uniform count as service. On Rakshak ID, Agniveers get the same privileges as any veteran.

Vizag, 2014. The posting truck leaves at 6 AM. Two fauji brats get one last evening.

Tara and Kabir, both 8, race their cycles round the Navy colony one last time. At the gate, no goodbye. Just a promise: "See you in whites."
2026, a week before Navy Day: on a ship's deck, a sailor in whites turns round. Same grin. Promise kept.

Fauji kids never say goodbye. Only "until we meet again."

🎁 फ़ौजी ब्रैट्स: रजिस्टर करने वाले पहले 500 को ख़ास ब्रांड वाउचर। लिंक बायो में।
